note: Reviewed findings of scripts/ci/cross-currency-sum-guard.mjs at its introduction (origin/main f6c261f9). Matching is by (file, rule, match); lineAtBaseline is informational. SAFE = single-currency by construction and enforced; LATENT = correct only because every row is ILS today; BROKEN = can add different currencies now. Removing an entry is how a fix is recorded; adding one requires a risk and a reviewed reason. See docs/money/FINANCIAL-DATA-MODEL-AUDIT.md.

findings.reason: name collision: `observed.amount` is a typed unit price for an inventory sale, not a guarded column; inventory prices carry no currency at all (InventorySaleLine.unitPrice), ILS assumed.
